fusions.name: Barbed Line
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed line at the first enemy in reach up to 8 tiles away, dealing 12 damage, stunning it for 1 second and healing you for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Barbed Pickings
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up: tears at it for 8 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Swing on the Line
fusions.desc: Swings you 6 tiles forward on a hooked line, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Pilfering Barbs
fusions.desc: Each time you strike, you snag back 3 mana. Once every 2 seconds.
